title: Post Project Wizard for Builders
description: Multi-step wizard form for builders to submit new projects with 5 steps: Basic Info, Unit Details, Media Upload, Additional Details, and Preview. Features localStorage draft persistence, dynamic unit builder, file upload support, comprehensive validation, and SSOT integration using local file storage.
features: Step 1: Basic Info (name, type, city, location, builder, price range)
Step 2: Dynamic Unit Builder (add/remove units with BHK, size, price, status)
Step 3: Media Upload (images, videos, brochures, floor plans) - COMING SOON state
Step 4: Additional Details (amenities, description, possession date, RERA)
Step 5: Preview & Submit with all data review
Backend API endpoint POST /public/post-project with SSOT integration
acceptance_criteria: All 5 steps functional with proper validation
Draft persistence works across page reloads
Backend saves to BuilderProject + Contact + Interaction (SSOT)
result_summary: Complete 5-step post project wizard implemented with all features. Draft persistence, dynamic unit builder, validation, and SSOT integration all functional. Media upload shows 'coming soon' placeholder. Backend endpoint integrated with local file storage. Builds with zero errors and full dark mode support.
